_about: This file is PUBLIC. Edit the values below and the daily workflow does the rest. Only write things you would say out loud: no passwords, no real names of other people, nothing from private notes. 'public' is only a fallback: every day the script asks GitHub which repos are really public and uses that. A repo that is private shows its card without a link and is left out of the spotlight.

now.text: my own photo viewer, in a calm *Moonlight* look. Open a photo, zoom, flick to the next one, and nothing else gets in the way. It is the app I already use instead of Windows Photos.
my own native notepad, in a *Sumeru scholar* look: deep green night, gold, and a leaf of lime. A quick, tidy replacement for Windows Notepad.

notes: Every big app starts as|one ugly button.
Night is just daytime|with better lighting.
Ship the small thing.|Polish it tomorrow.
A tidy folder is a|waypoint you can trust.
Read the error message.|It is usually right.
Make it work first.|Then make it pretty.
A good name saves|an hour of explaining.
Learn one small thing|every single day.
Small apps, big feelings.|Pick one and finish it.
Dark mode is not a setting.|It is a way of life.

projects.name: Waypoint
projects.what: A Genshin-inspired file manager: drives are "levels", folders are waypoints, and the Recycle Bin is called Salvage. Has a disk map and live backgrounds.

projects.name: Leyline
projects.what: A task manager where your programs are a party and the heavy ones get a "boss fight" banner. Also a game overlay and a disk map.

projects.name: Toolbelt
projects.what: One app for the everyday things I would otherwise need a dozen websites for. Everything runs on your own PC.

projects.name: Housecall
projects.what: Finds and fixes computer problems. It only looks until you say yes, and nothing is installed.

projects.name: Courier
projects.what: Send text, clipboard and files between your own devices over your own Wi-Fi: no cloud, no account. PC, desktop and Android apps.

projects.name: Reveille
projects.what: Start, shut down, restart, sleep and lock your computer from your phone, over home Wi-Fi.

projects.name: Terminal
projects.what: A custom look for Windows Terminal and PowerShell: a see-through theme, a welcome screen, live PC status and short commands.

projects.name: Clipboard
projects.what: A clipboard history: copy as usual, press a hotkey, pick any earlier clip.

projects.name: Snipper
projects.what: A snipping tool with a text reader built in: drag a box, mark it up, or copy the words out of a picture.

projects.name: Custom Clock
projects.what: A two-line clock for the Windows 11 taskbar: date and time on top, CPU, GPU, RAM or media below.

projects.name: Crosshairs
projects.what: A see-through, click-through crosshair overlay for your games, with a separate save for each game.

projects.name: Launcher (Seelie)
projects.what: An Android home-screen launcher with live wallpapers, an A-Z app list, a night screen and a PIN vault. Written in Kotlin.
projects.after: Reveille and Courier have Android apps too (see above).

projects.name: Leerlantaarn (was Leeromgeving)
projects.what: A study site for Dutch VMBO students: summaries, flashcards with spaced repetition and a practice game. The app is in Dutch.

projects.name: Akasha Terminal
projects.what: A night-and-gold dashboard for a Genshin Impact account: daily routine, wish counter, roster and an artifact lab.

projects.name: Irminsul
projects.what: A night-blue, cream and gold theme for VS Code, with the seven elements as colours.
